sources.title: Haiti Directorate of Immigration and Emigration: passport application
sources.publisher: Direction de l’Immigration et de l’Émigration, Ministry of Interior, Haiti
sources.officialityEvidence: Haiti's Interior Ministry immigration directorate states that the Haitian Government issues passports to its nationals and requires proof of Haitian citizenship.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le passeport est un document délivré par le gouvernement Haïtien à ses ressortissants.

sources.title: Haiti Tax Directorate: passport duty
sources.publisher: Direction Générale des Impôts, Republic of Haiti
sources.officialityEvidence: Haiti's Tax Directorate describes the simple 32- and 48-page passport and its ordinary validity periods.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Le passeport simple de 32 pages ... valide pour une durée de 5 ans pour les mineurs et de 10 ans pour les majeurs.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 tourism F5A visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document expressly makes F5A tourism available to citizens of all countries and sends the visa certificate by email.
sources.supportingExcerpt: F5A- TOURISM VISA ... Eligibility: Citizens of all countries ... Receive Visa certificate via email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa is operational
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The institutional Government page confirms that equatorialguinea-evisa.com is the operational visa site and says all interested visitors can obtain a visa online without an in-person visit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: todos los interesados en viajar al país podrán conseguir su visado sin tener que desplazarse físicamente.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live eligibility and electronic delivery translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain currently serves its live Angular English translation asset. The asset says all nationalities may apply and that all eVisas are emailed and downloadable as PDF.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E- Visa ... All E-Visa are sent by email.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live regular-passport translation asset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government-authenticated exact domain's live translation asset expressly limits the eVisa application to the regular passport used for travel and excludes other travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The only travel document that can be used ... is your regular passport.

policies.title: Haitian ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism service makes an online tourism eVisa available to citizens of all countries and delivers the visa certificate by email.
conditions: Use a valid Haitian ordinary passport with at least six months' validity, photo, return ticket, hotel or host evidence and sufficient funds. F5A is tourism only, single-entry and up to 30 days.
Apply online, upload documents and pay the fee. The visa certificate is emailed, so this is electronic issuance rather than online preapproval followed by border issuance.

Nigeria excepts ECOWAS States and countries with visa-waiver agreements. The current F5A material does not identify a Haitian ordinary-passport exception, so this generic route is retained at medium confidence. Work, residence, special passports, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa application
steps: Apply online using the Haitian ordinary passport and upload the tourism documents.
Pay the fee and await the emailed visa certificate before travel.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Haitian ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's institutional Government page authenticates its online visa service; the live translation asset on that exact domain accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email/PDF.
conditions: Apply using the Haitian ordinary passport that will be used for travel; the live official translation asset excludes non-regular travel documents.
Register, upload the required visitor documents, pay online and obtain the eVisa by email/PDF before travel. This is electronic issuance, not an ETA or visa on arrival.
Purpose, passport validity, health, entry-point, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Register and submit the visitor eVisa application with the Haitian ordinary passport to be used for travel.
Pay online and receive the issued eVisa by email/PDF before travel.
Carry the issued record and meet entry-point and final-admission conditions.
